question: Should the official-publisher administration API permanently expose `claimState`, `officialState`, and `restrictionState` as this PR defines them?
rationale: The patch introduces a compatibility-sensitive trust vocabulary whose semantics will guide downstream consumers; code review cannot determine whether this is the intended long-term product contract.

options.title: Approve the separated state contract
options.body: Keep the three distinct facts, correct the active-member derivation, and require runtime proof before merging.

options.title: Defer the contract
options.body: Pause this API addition until a concrete admin or feed consumer establishes the required state semantics and lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Approve the separated state contract
recommendation.body: Keep the three distinct facts, correct the active-member derivation, and require runtime proof before merging.
